title: woww: Update 1.12 (Vanilla) messages
description:
Updates some incorrect messages and adds details and enums for others.

After this I will work on getting the `UpdateMask` and `AuraMask` types working.

Progresses https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/issues/17481.

notes.body:
added 2 commits
  • bc10c8a5 - woww: Remove unused variables
  • da79d787 - woww: Fix not using VALS64 for item_class_and_sub_class
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/9744/diffs?diff_id=598757163&start_sha=0244fd1edc12ecc705af1f2478464a3bcaca867c)

CI claims that `Warning: Found shadow variable(s) in /builds/gtker/wireshark/epan/dissectors/packet-woww.c : index`, but the only variable called `index` is at https://gitlab.com/gtker/wireshark/-/blob/woww/epan/dissectors/packet-woww.c#L10620 and it does not shadow any other variables.

`index` is a C library function which has been deprecated for a long time, but is still present on some OSes: https://man.freebsd.org/cgi/man.cgi?query=index&apropos=0&sektion=3&manpath=FreeBSD+14.0-CURRENT&arch=default&format=html

> `index` is a C library function which has been deprecated for a long time, but is still present on some OSes: https://man.freebsd.org/cgi/man.cgi?query=index&apropos=0&sektion=3&manpath=FreeBSD+14.0-CURRENT&arch=default&format=html

Ah, OK, I'll push a fix.

added 1 commit
  • 134f95cd - woww: Fix `index` variable shadowing global C function
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/9744/diffs?diff_id=598773976&start_sha=da79d787e97243e4a91f3ac3c78f696748e5090f)
the check can be remove i think (some old mac os release don't like the index variable name...)

added 2 commits
  • e839fab7 - woww: Fix `index` variable shadowing global C function
  • 5bd00b45 - woww: Fix missing BASE_VAL64_STRING for 64 bit type
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/9744/diffs?diff_id=598899386&start_sha=134f95cd1df067fbd5f25da4bf744c597148cfa7)

CI gave `Error: hf_woww_item_class_and_sub_class uses VALS64 but 'display' does not include BASE_VAL64_STRING in epan/dissectors/packet-woww.c`.

I believe that I have fixed it in https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/9744/diffs?commit_id=5bd00b45b3414fd74edd15daeae3912f7003e58b although I'm not entirely clear on what exactly is wrong since 32 bit `VALS` do not seem to require it.
Yes, at least CI isn't complaining any more.
